study type: Exploratory subgroup analysis of a Randomized Controlled Trial
cohort: 14,923 women randomised within 3 hours of delivery who experienced post-partum haemorrhage.
finding: Tranexamic acid significantly reduced the risk of death from exsanguination in women with postpartum haemorrhage, especially after excluding early deaths, but it was uncertain if it reduced the risk of hysterectomy for bleeding after excluding early hysterectomies.
